answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 20787 Country: India Title: The one who studied degree by educational loan (interest). Now that person joined job. Is that salary halal or haram? Question: Assalaamu Alaikkum mufti sb.. The one who studied degree by educational loan (interest). Now that person joined job. Is that salary halal or haram? Answer ID: 20787 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 553/353/L=1431) Salary would be halal, it cannot be termed haram provided the job is of lawful nature. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
